title: Agent-Assisted Phone Payment Fee on Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing Accounts
content:
**Policy.** For a payment taken through a phone agent, and only for such a payment, the fee it carries is the agent-assisted fee set out in this policy in place of the plan's flat phone payment fee; it is still charged once per payment, on the payment's posting date and naming that payment, and autopay, online portal and mailed payments stay free. The phone payment fee is not charged while an approved hardship deferral is in effect. The plan attribute that gives a flat phone payment fee for a payment made through a phone agent describes the base fee; for a payment this policy covers, the agent-assisted fee set out in this policy governs, and the flat fee is its standard amount.

This policy belongs to Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing and covers every plan.

## What posting does

The fee is booked on the account as a new phone-payment fee entry, dated on the posting date given, naming the payment taken through a phone agent that it concerns and that payment's statement period. It raises the amount owed on the account by the fee and shows on the borrower's account history.

## Points of judgement

| Payment channel | Agent-assisted fee |
|---|---|
| Phone agent | Charged once per payment, on the payment's posting date, naming that payment |
| Autopay | Free |
| Online portal | Free |
| Mailed payment | Free |

While an approved hardship deferral is in effect, no phone payment fee is charged.

## Invocation

The tool is `post_finance_phone_fee_cbbb3871`. It is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `finance_account_id` | The reference number of the financing account the fee is charged to, as returned by the financing account lookup | Identifier |
| `source_finance_txn_id` | The reference number of the payment taken through a phone agent that the fee concerns, as returned by the financing history lookup | Identifier |
| `statement_period` | The statement period of the payment the fee concerns | YYYY-MM; never empty |
| `posting_date` | The date the fee is booked on; it is the posting date of the payment the fee concerns | YYYY-MM-DD; never empty |
| `amount` | The fee charged, in USD | A positive amount with 2 decimal places; stored rounded to 2 decimal places |

## Return

A successful call returns `finance_txn_id` (the reference number of the new fee entry), `finance_account_id` (the account charged), `source_finance_txn_id` (the payment named), `statement_period` (YYYY-MM), `posted_on` (YYYY-MM-DD, the booking date), `amount` (USD with 2 decimal places) and `status` (the word posted when the fee was booked).
